title: v5.108.0 shipped: Guest mode split: night-stay GUEST, visitors_present, Guest left button
summary: Guest mode split: night-stay GUEST, visitors_present, Guest left button
why: GUEST used to switch on from a 30-minute guest-room gate (plus WiFi), so the house spent hours in GUEST with no guest. The operator set a high bar: a guest is someone who sleeps in a guest room. GUEST now needs one qualifying night plus same-room daytime, yields to normal sleep at night, ends after at most 2 empty nights, re-enters within 7 days on one night, and has a Guest left button. visitors_present is display-only. Exterior circling and no-resident door alerts stay HIGH while in GUEST.
implications: Shipped GUEST-MODE-SPLIT-VISITORS-1 at v5.108.0; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.0.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Retune thresholds after the next 2-3 real stays (they were fitted on one October stay); HVAC-GUEST-EVIDENCE-RULE-1 next; revisit if a resident nap in a guest room enters GUEST
